reviews.title: My i5 8400T was delivered as promised.
reviews.comment: Intel "T" series processors win the "cool, quiet, dependable, long lasting" benchmark. Product is working great. All 6 cores are idling at about 20 degrees C (68 degrees F) with a Noctua D9L fan. Passmark CPU Mark was 10399 (Gigabyte Z390M motherboard).
reviews.author: Charles Hill
